Welcome

This is the AsriyyaMUN’27 website. We’re glad that you stopped by. Now in its 16th year, AsriyyaMUN has grown into one of the top MUN conferences held in Amman — three days of energetic debate, cooperation, and memorable outcomes at the Landmark Hotel, Amman.
